authors.bio: Mr. Tetsuo Imai was born on August 27, 1927. He received a B.S. degree in Communication Engineering from Tohoku University in 1950. He joined Nippon Electric Co., Limited in 1955 and is now General Manager of the Broadcast System Division. His principal work has been in the development of Radio and TV Studio Equipment. Mr. Imai is a member of the Institute of Electronics and Communication Engineers of Japan and the Institute of Television Engineers of Japan.
